page.overview:
Who is Flight Lieutenant Richard?

Richard was a minor character in the 1979 film Moonraker. He was played by Kim Fortune.

Richard was an R.A.F. Officer. He was seen in pre-title sequence on a Boeing 747 which transported a Moonraker shuttle to England. During the transportation two thief came out to the shuttle and hijacked it in the air. The Boeing 747 explosed and killed Richard and the crew on the board.
